newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD bid specs due in 30 days.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD bid specs due in 30 days.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said Wednesday the tender details for the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) would be ready in 30 days.

Kandir told reporters after a meeting of the National Privatization Council (CND) that CVRD's base price would be set "at auction". It was unclear whether he meant at the time the auction details would be announced or at the sale itself.
Kandir said the CND had agreed to give the National Development Bank (BNDES) 30 days to finalize the bid specifications for CVRD.
He said the CND had also decided to issue debentures to cover future revenue from known mineral deposits, such as the Carajas iron ore project.

With regard to unknown mineral deposits, Kandir said CVRD and the BNDES had agreed to jointly invest up to 300 million reais in what amounted to a joint venture to explore and develop those undiscovered deposits.

Kandir said he felt "comfortable" that this solution would ensure the National Treasury did not miss out on future windfalls and that the government would not be charging too high a price to private investors for debentures.
The planning minister said the BNDES could sell its share of the venture to CVRD's future private owners if it wanted to.
In recent weeks, mounting speculation about large gold and copper deposits has led to calls for the CVRD sell-off to be delayed, at least until those finds can be evaluated.
